caption: Stop-and-wait on a 100 kbps link with 1000-bit frames and 20 ms one-way delay: each 10 ms frame is followed by 40 ms of waiting, so one cycle is 50 ms. ACK boxes are widened for labels; their transmission time is neglected.

spec.aria: Two timelines: the sender transmits a 10 ms frame, sits idle for a 40 ms round trip, then transmits the next frame, while the receiver sends back an acknowledgement that reaches the sender 20 ms after it leaves.
